182 sources · 290 claims · 393 evidence items · 27 targets · 129 facet assessments · 28 audits · 101 state variables

Generated 2026-09-17 · offline and self-contained · no external scripts, styles or fonts
Nothing in this graph is a safety or efficacy claim. An edge records that somebody reported something, with provenance — not that it is true, reproducible, or applicable to a healthy adult human. A well-connected node is not a well-evidenced one: check the claim count, the distinct source count and the coverage figures in the side panel before reading anything into a node's position or its number of edges. Dashed red edges are null results — a performed attempt that detected no effect — and they are excluded from every support count.

A null result is a performed and reported attempt that detected no effect. It is a finding, not a gap: an untested relationship has no edge at all. Null edges never count as support, and a chain containing one is not a chain of evidence.

Claim-derived but not support means the claim states no direction, or states no_change or unclear. An absent sign is not a positive one.

Click a node to see its attributes and provenance. For a target you will also get its coverage figures, which are the honest counterweight to how connected it looks.

Generated by blueprint.reports.graph_html from the curated records. Every edge carries a provenance class; claim-derived edges carry the claim ids that licensed them. claim_type: evidence_gap claims appear in the evidence layer only and compile to no biological or intervention edge, because an absence of measurement is not a finding about biology.
